A shocking incident at Assam Engineering College in Guwahati has raised serious questions about student safety, hygiene and administrative accountability. A dead monkey was reportedly found inside a hostel water tank, following complaints of foul-smelling water. More than 50 students reportedly fell ill, with symptoms including stomach pain, vomiting and fever.
According to media reports, students staying at Hostel No. 7 had complained about the quality of water. The situation came to light after students inspected the overhead water tank and discovered the monkey's carcass inside.
